title: Question 13
stem: A parallel beam of $\gamma$-ray photons passes through lead of thickness $x$. The initial intensity is $I_0$ and the transmitted intensity is $I$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by a $\gamma$-ray photon.

markscheme_points.text: packet / quantum / photon of electromagnetic radiation

hints: Hint 1: Recall the formal Cambridge definition regarding gamma rays. State clearly the physical conditions and quantities involved.
Hint 2: Rearrange the algebraic equation to isolate the target variable before substituting numerical values.
parts.proper_answer: packet / quantum / photon of electromagnetic radiation; emitted from atomic nuclei
walkthrough:
Step 1: **Identify Governing Principle**
State the core physical principle governing this problem: Gamma rays. Identify the relationship between the given quantities.

Step 2: **Substitute Values & Calculate**
Work through the substitution and calculation systematically:
packet / quantum / photon of electromagnetic radiation; emitted from atomic nuclei
Verify intermediate arithmetic carefully.

Step 3: **Units & Significant Figures**
State the final result clearly with appropriate significant figures (typically 2 or 3 s.f.) and standard SI units.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Use Fig. 13.1 to determine the linear absorption coefficient $\mu$ of lead for these $\gamma$-ray photons.
